title: 基礎醫學：解剖、生理、生化、微生物
intro: 醫學院基礎科學的核心單元。 本科包含原創虛擬病例與另標示的課程模板；請依選單切換。
introEn: Core preclinical science units. This specialty includes original fictional cases and separately labelled course templates.

procedures.title: 兩區室模型：梯度不是粒子停止
procedures.titleEn: Two compartments: equilibrium does not mean particles stop
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：教學模型有兩個等體積區室、共一百粒子，學員比較分布。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A teaching model has equal-volume compartments and one hundred particles.

stages.title: 建立問題
stages.evidence: 左八十、右二十，體積相同。
stages.evidenceEn: Eighty particles are left and twenty right at equal volumes.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 指出被動擴散的淨驅動方向
choices.en: Identify the net passive-diffusion driving direction

choices.zh: 認為少量的一側必定流向大量側
choices.en: Assume particles must flow toward the larger count

stages.reason: 同體積下粒子數可比較濃度。
stages.reasonEn: Particle counts compare concentration only at equal volumes.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：認為少量的一側必定流向大量側；同體積下粒子數可比較濃度。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Assume particles must flow toward the larger count; Particle counts compare concentration only at equal volumes.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 調整到左右各五十。
stages.evidenceEn: The model is changed to fifty on each side.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 認為所有粒子因此停止運動
choices.en: Assume every particle stops moving

choices.zh: 辨識沒有淨濃度差
choices.en: Recognise the absence of a net gradient

stages.reason: 動態平衡仍可有雙向移動。
stages.reasonEn: Dynamic equilibrium can include movement both ways.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：認為所有粒子因此停止運動；動態平衡仍可有雙向移動。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Assume every particle stops moving; Dynamic equilibrium can include movement both ways.

stages.title: 檢查限制
stages.evidence: 有人改成兩側體積不同。
stages.evidenceEn: Someone proposes unequal compartment volumes.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 重新計算濃度而非只比數量
choices.en: Compare concentration rather than counts alone

choices.zh: 仍直接用粒子數判定梯度
choices.en: Continue inferring gradients from counts alone

stages.reason: 濃度還取決於體積。
stages.reasonEn: Concentration also depends on volume.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：仍直接用粒子數判定梯度；濃度還取決於體積。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Continue inferring gradients from counts alone; Concentration also depends on volume.

stages.title: 整合判斷
stages.evidence: 想用這個圖預測真實細胞反應。
stages.evidenceEn: A learner wants to predict a real cell’s response.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 宣稱模型包含所有細胞機制
choices.en: Claim the model includes all cellular mechanisms

choices.zh: 指出膜通透性與主動運輸被省略
choices.en: State that permeability and active transport are omitted

stages.reason: 簡化機制不能直接替代完整生理。
stages.reasonEn: A simplified mechanism cannot replace full physiology.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：宣稱模型包含所有細胞機制；簡化機制不能直接替代完整生理。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Claim the model includes all cellular mechanisms; A simplified mechanism cannot replace full physiology.

stages.title: 交班與再評估
stages.evidence: 交班固定總量、體積假設、梯度方向與模型未納入的因素。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over conserved particles, volume assumptions, gradient direction and omitted factors.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 交班未解問題及指定追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over uncertainties and name the follow-up owner

choices.zh: 只交付病名，不必交付證據
choices.en: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence

stages.reason: 交班必須保留：交班固定總量、體積假設、梯度方向與模型未納入的因素。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over conserved particles, volume assumptions, gradient direction and omitted factors.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只交付病名，不必交付證據；交班必須保留：交班固定總量、體積假設、梯度方向與模型未納入的因素。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence; The handover must preserve: Hand over conserved particles, volume assumptions, gradient direction and omitted factors.

procedures.title: 稀釋後濃度下降：物質真的消失嗎？
procedures.titleEn: Lower concentration after dilution: did material disappear?
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：虛擬檢驗練習將同一份教學溶液加入溶劑，不涉及實際生物樣本。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A virtual laboratory adds solvent to a teaching solution without using biological samples.

stages.title: 建立問題
stages.evidence: 物質量不變，總體積增加。
stages.evidenceEn: The amount of material stays fixed while total volume increases.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 濃度下降就代表物質被消滅
choices.en: Lower concentration means material was destroyed

choices.zh: 區分物質總量與濃度
choices.en: Distinguish total amount from concentration

stages.reason: 濃度是每單位體積的量。
stages.reasonEn: Concentration expresses amount per unit volume.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：濃度下降就代表物質被消滅；濃度是每單位體積的量。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Lower concentration means material was destroyed; Concentration expresses amount per unit volume.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 兩份紀錄使用不同體積單位。
stages.evidenceEn: Two records use different volume units.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 先統一單位再比較
choices.en: Align units before comparing

choices.zh: 只比較數字大小
choices.en: Compare numerical magnitude alone

stages.reason: 單位不同會造成表面差異。
stages.reasonEn: Different units can create apparent differences.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只比較數字大小；單位不同會造成表面差異。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Compare numerical magnitude alone; Different units can create apparent differences.

stages.title: 檢查限制
stages.evidence: 圖表沒寫稀釋前後的總體積。
stages.evidenceEn: The chart omits volumes before and after dilution.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 憑圖的顏色猜出精準濃度
choices.en: Infer an exact concentration from colour

choices.zh: 標記資料不足而不猜算
choices.en: Mark insufficient data instead of guessing

stages.reason: 定量需要已知量與可靠量測。
stages.reasonEn: Quantification needs known quantities and reliable measurement.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：憑圖的顏色猜出精準濃度；定量需要已知量與可靠量測。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Infer an exact concentration from colour; Quantification needs known quantities and reliable measurement.

stages.title: 整合判斷
stages.evidence: 學員想把示例換成個人藥物濃度。
stages.evidenceEn: A learner wants to apply the example to a personal drug concentration.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 指出人體有吸收分布與消除
choices.en: Explain absorption, distribution and elimination differences

choices.zh: 把人體直接當成靜止玻璃杯
choices.en: Treat the body as a static beaker

stages.reason: 靜態稀釋不等於藥物動力學。
stages.reasonEn: Static dilution is not pharmacokinetics.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：把人體直接當成靜止玻璃杯；靜態稀釋不等於藥物動力學。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Treat the body as a static beaker; Static dilution is not pharmacokinetics.

stages.title: 交班與再評估
stages.evidence: 交班物質量、體積單位、資料缺漏與靜態模型的適用範圍。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over amount, volume units, missing information and the static model’s scope.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 只交付病名，不必交付證據
choices.en: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence

choices.zh: 交班未解問題及指定追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over uncertainties and name the follow-up owner

stages.reason: 交班必須保留：交班物質量、體積單位、資料缺漏與靜態模型的適用範圍。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over amount, volume units, missing information and the static model’s scope.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只交付病名，不必交付證據；交班必須保留：交班物質量、體積單位、資料缺漏與靜態模型的適用範圍。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence; The handover must preserve: Hand over amount, volume units, missing information and the static model’s scope.

procedures.title: 顯微照片比較：分清觀察與推論
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：兩張教學細胞照片亮度不同，學員推論較亮的一張有更多細胞。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: Two teaching micrographs differ in brightness; a learner infers more cells in the brighter image.

stages.title: 建立問題
stages.evidence: 亮度不同，拍攝與染色條件未知。
stages.evidenceEn: Brightness differs while acquisition and staining conditions are unknown.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 先描述亮度並保留原因不確定性
choices.en: Describe brightness while leaving its cause uncertain

choices.zh: 直接把亮度當細胞數量
choices.en: Treat brightness directly as cell count

stages.reason: 顯示與取得條件可能改變外觀。
stages.reasonEn: Display and acquisition conditions can alter appearance.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：直接把亮度當細胞數量；顯示與取得條件可能改變外觀。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Treat brightness directly as cell count; Display and acquisition conditions can alter appearance.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 兩張照片倍率與視野不同。
stages.evidenceEn: Magnification and field size differ.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 直接比較畫面內全部圖形數量
choices.en: Compare all visible shapes without adjustment

choices.zh: 核對尺度與可比較區域
choices.en: Check scale and comparable areas

stages.reason: 不同視野不能直接代表相同樣本量。
stages.reasonEn: Different fields do not represent identical sampled areas.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：直接比較畫面內全部圖形數量；不同視野不能直接代表相同樣本量。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Compare all visible shapes without adjustment; Different fields do not represent identical sampled areas.

stages.title: 檢查限制
stages.evidence: 邊緣濾鏡讓部分輪廓變明顯。
stages.evidenceEn: An edge filter makes some outlines more visible.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 把濾鏡當呈現工具而非計數驗證
choices.en: Use the filter for display, not count validation

choices.zh: 把每條邊緣認定為獨立細胞
choices.en: Call every edge a separate cell

stages.reason: 影像演算法特徵不等於生物實體。
stages.reasonEn: Algorithmic features are not necessarily biological objects.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：把每條邊緣認定為獨立細胞；影像演算法特徵不等於生物實體。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Call every edge a separate cell; Algorithmic features are not necessarily biological objects.

stages.title: 整合判斷
stages.evidence: 需要回答是否有真正的族群差異。
stages.evidenceEn: The question is whether populations truly differ.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 由兩張漂亮圖片直接宣告差異
choices.en: Declare a difference from two attractive pictures

choices.zh: 要求一致取樣與可靠測量方法
choices.en: Require consistent sampling and reliable measurement

stages.reason: 研究推論需要方法與資料品質。
stages.reasonEn: Research inference requires methods and data quality.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：由兩張漂亮圖片直接宣告差異；研究推論需要方法與資料品質。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Declare a difference from two attractive pictures; Research inference requires methods and data quality.

stages.title: 交班與再評估
stages.evidence: 交班倍率尺度、染色曝光、取樣範圍及觀察與推論的界線。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over scale, staining and exposure, sampling scope and the observation-inference distinction.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 交班未解問題及指定追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over uncertainties and name the follow-up owner

choices.zh: 只交付病名，不必交付證據
choices.en: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence

stages.reason: 交班必須保留：交班倍率尺度、染色曝光、取樣範圍及觀察與推論的界線。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over scale, staining and exposure, sampling scope and the observation-inference distinction.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只交付病名，不必交付證據；交班必須保留：交班倍率尺度、染色曝光、取樣範圍及觀察與推論的界線。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence; The handover must preserve: Hand over scale, staining and exposure, sampling scope and the observation-inference distinction.

procedures.title: 陰性結果前：品質控制有沒有通過？
procedures.titleEn: Before a negative result: did quality control pass?
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：虛擬分析練習中，待測樣本沒有訊號，但預期有訊號的控制也失敗。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: In a virtual analysis, the sample has no signal and the expected-positive control also fails.

stages.title: 建立問題
stages.evidence: 待測樣本與陽性控制都沒有訊號。
stages.evidenceEn: Both sample and expected-positive control lack a signal.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 直接報告樣本一定陰性
choices.en: Report the sample as definitely negative

choices.zh: 先懷疑此輪分析有效性
choices.en: Question the validity of this analytical run

stages.reason: 控制失敗限制結果的可解釋性。
stages.reasonEn: Control failure limits interpretability.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：直接報告樣本一定陰性；控制失敗限制結果的可解釋性。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Report the sample as definitely negative; Control failure limits interpretability.

stages.title: 更新證據
stages.evidence: 另一輪空白控制出現訊號。
stages.evidenceEn: A blank control shows a signal in another run.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 追查背景、污染或系統問題
choices.en: Investigate background, contamination or system issues

choices.zh: 把空白訊號當成病人證據
choices.en: Treat the blank signal as patient evidence

stages.reason: 空白控制不是病人的檢體結果。
stages.reasonEn: A blank control is not a patient result.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：把空白訊號當成病人證據；空白控制不是病人的檢體結果。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Treat the blank signal as patient evidence; A blank control is not a patient result.

stages.title: 檢查限制
stages.evidence: 重複兩次得到相近數字，但控制仍異常。
stages.evidenceEn: Repeated values agree while controls remain abnormal.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 重複一致就保證測量正確
choices.en: Agreement guarantees correctness

choices.zh: 區分重複性與正確性
choices.en: Distinguish repeatability from accuracy

stages.reason: 一致的偏差仍可能重複出現。
stages.reasonEn: A consistent bias can be reproducible.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：重複一致就保證測量正確；一致的偏差仍可能重複出現。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Agreement guarantees correctness; A consistent bias can be reproducible.

stages.title: 整合判斷
stages.evidence: 學員想隱去失敗批次只保留漂亮結果。
stages.evidenceEn: A learner wants to hide failed runs and keep attractive results.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 保留完整紀錄與調查結果
choices.en: Preserve the full record and investigation

choices.zh: 只保存符合預期的結果
choices.en: Keep only expected results

stages.reason: 可追溯品質需要完整資訊。
stages.reasonEn: Traceable quality requires complete information.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只保存符合預期的結果；可追溯品質需要完整資訊。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Keep only expected results; Traceable quality requires complete information.

stages.title: 交班與再評估
stages.evidence: 交班控制狀態、批次資料、結果限制、調查與重新評估責任。
stages.evidenceEn: Hand over control status, run records, limitations, investigation and reassessment ownership.
stages.question: 依目前資料，哪個判斷較合理？
stages.questionEn: Which interpretation is better supported by the current evidence?

choices.zh: 只交付病名，不必交付證據
choices.en: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence

choices.zh: 交班未解問題及指定追蹤者
choices.en: Hand over uncertainties and name the follow-up owner

stages.reason: 交班必須保留：交班控制狀態、批次資料、結果限制、調查與重新評估責任。
stages.reasonEn: The handover must preserve: Hand over control status, run records, limitations, investigation and reassessment ownership.
stages.pitfall: 不要直接推論：只交付病名，不必交付證據；交班必須保留：交班控制狀態、批次資料、結果限制、調查與重新評估責任。
stages.pitfallEn: Avoid concluding: Hand over only a diagnosis without its supporting evidence; The handover must preserve: Hand over control status, run records, limitations, investigation and reassessment ownership.

procedures.title: 胸腔解剖
procedures.patient: 依課程「胸腔解剖」設定的虛擬情境：心臟、肺、縱膈與大血管的立體關係。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Thoracic anatomy": Heart, lungs, mediastinum and great vessels. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

stations.zh: 關鍵要素 3：縱膈與大血管…
stations.en: Key element 3: mediastinum and great vessels

procedures.title: 腹部解剖
procedures.patient: 依課程「腹部解剖」設定的虛擬情境：腹膜腔、器官與血管分佈。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Abdominal anatomy": Peritoneal cavity, organs and vascular supply. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

stations.zh: 關鍵要素 2：器官與血管分佈
stations.en: Key element 2: organs and vascular supply

procedures.title: 頭頸解剖
procedures.patient: 依課程「頭頸解剖」設定的虛擬情境：腦神經、頸部三角與顏面血管。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Head and neck anatomy": Cranial nerves, neck triangles and facial vessels. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Validity and limitations of medical simulation": Distinguish illustrative models and patient data; Compare task fluency and clinical competence; Recognize assumptions errors and validation needs The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
